verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਐਸੋ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sa(n)gat milaap ko prataap aaiso patibrat ek Tek dhubidhaa nivaaree hai ||

en.bdb: The union of a Sikh with his Guru and becoming one with him is like a faithful wife who discards the desire of others and lives in the refuge of one husband.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਛਤ ਨ ਜੋਤਕ ਅਉ ਬੇਦ ਥਿਤਿ ਵਾਰ ਕਛੁ॥ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅਉ ਨਖਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਨ ਸੰਕਾ ਉਰਧਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: poochhat na jotak aau bedh thit vaar kachhu|| gireh aau nakhatr kee na sa(n)kaa uradhaaree hai ||

en.bdb: The Sikh who places his faith in the refuge of one True Guru, does not depend upon astrology or the command of Vedas, nor does he bring any doubt about the auspiciousness of a day/date or constellation of stars/planets to his mind.
